In the fourth quarter of the NFL game between Patriots and Seahawks, scheduled for September 9 at 8:20 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Seahawks" if the Seahawks outscore the Patriots by 2 or more points in the fourth quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Patriots".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: The Patriots open the 2026 regular season on the road against the Seahawks in a Week 1 rematch of Super Bowl LX at Lumen Field. Seattle enters with home-field advantage and roster continuity, while New England has focused on bolstering its offensive line via trade and managing early absences, including linebacker Harold Landry on the PUP list and safety Brenden Schooler on NFI. Both teams rested key starters like quarterbacks Drake Maye and Sam Darnold throughout the preseason, leaving recent form and health as primary variables. Seahawks running back Zach Charbonnet remains on PUP and unavailable for the opener, while ongoing contract talks with Patriots cornerback Christian Gonzalez add roster uncertainty. These injury designations, combined with Seattle’s recent postseason success against New England, shape current trader consensus around the matchup.
